newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996 motorcycle output falls 6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996 motorcycle output falls 6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production fell 6.0 percent from a year earlier to 2,587,636 units in calendar 1996, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers' Association (JAMA) said on Monday.
It was the first yearly production decline in two years.
JAMA also said Japan's domestic vehicle production fell 4.6 percent from a year earlier to 203,147 in December, the second straight month in which output fell on a year-on-year basis.

The association also said Japan's domestic sales of motorcycles rose 0.6 percent from a year earlier to 1,219,916 units in 1996, marking the second successive year-on-year gain.
It said it expected Japanese motorcycle exports in 1996 to have risen about two percent from a year earlier to 1.36 million units.
